documents.title: Array.prototype.flatMap()
documents.summary: The flatMap() method of Array instances returns a new array formed by applying a given callback function to each element of the array, and then flattening the result by one level. It is identical to a map() followed by a flat() of depth 1 (arr.map(...args).flat()), but slightly more efficient than calling those two methods separately.
